name: Repeated threshold breach
description: Same metric in breach in at least N of the last M reporting periods.

name: Multiple ratios in warning
description: At least N ratios are in warning state for the same reporting period.

name: Sharp deterioration
description: A ratio moved adversely by at least the configured percentage versus the prior period.

name: Adverse multi-period trend
description: A ratio declined in each of the last N consecutive periods.

name: Late or missing return
description: No submitted return for the period, or submitted after the due date.

name: Approaching regulatory threshold
description: Canonical metric has not breached but sits within the configured buffer of the breach threshold.

name: Repeated canonical breach
description: Same canonical metric breached in at least N accepted filing periods.

name: Adverse canonical movement
description: Canonical metric moved adversely by at least the configured percentage against the prior period.
